'''Faris''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and was friends with [[Pyrron Nox]] and [[Wrune Tsallin]]. During a visit to a [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] office, Faris and Nox talked about Tsallin, who was working for [[Sprax]] and [[Jatayus Outbound]]. Faris informed Nox that Jatayus was a front for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. During the trip to the office, Faris and Nox learned from [[Clerk/Legends|clerk]], [[Lommbo]], that Tsallin had been found dead, floating in the [[Ac'fren Spur]].<ref name="SSR" />
